import re
from decimal import Decimal
from datetime import datetime

fs_token=login['access_token']
base_dir='~/bills/internet/'
current_year=datetime.now().year
print('year', current_year)

# Gather expected file paths for this year from directory listing (read once)
dir_paths=apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=fs_token, directory_path='~/bills/internet/', entry_type='files', recursive=True)
print('dir_paths_count', len(dir_paths))
print('sample', dir_paths[:10])

# Build mapping month->paths; prefer txt then pdf
month_re=re.compile(r'/(\d{4})-(\d{2})\.(txt|pdf)$')
files_by_month={}
for p in dir_paths:
    m=month_re.search(p)
    if not m: 
        continue
    y=int(m.group(1)); mo=m.group(2); ext=m.group(3)
    if y!=current_year:
        continue
    files_by_month.setdefault(mo, []).append(p)

print('months_found', sorted(files_by_month.keys()))

# Function: parse amount from extracted text

def parse_total_from_text(text):
    # handles both '$72' and '72'
    m=re.search(r"Total Amount\s*=>\s*\$?\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)", text)
    if not m:
        m=re.search(r"Total Amount\s*=>\s*\$?\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)\s", text)
    if not m:
        raise ValueError('Total Amount not found')
    return Decimal(m.group(1))

amounts={}

for mo in sorted(files_by_month.keys()):
    candidates=files_by_month[mo]
    chosen_txt=[p for p in candidates if p.endswith('.txt')]
    chosen_pdf=[p for p in candidates if p.endswith('.pdf')]
    chosen=None
    if chosen_txt:
        chosen=sorted(chosen_txt)[0]
    else:
        chosen=sorted(chosen_pdf)[0]
    print('month', mo, 'chosen', chosen)
    f=apis.file_system.show_file(access_token=fs_token, file_path=chosen)
    content=f['content']
    if chosen.endswith('.txt'):
        text=content
    else:
        # pdf: content may be 'binary:HEX...'
        if isinstance(content,str) and content.startswith('binary:'):
            payload=content[len('binary:'):]
            data=bytes.fromhex(payload)
            # Try decoding to latin1 to preserve byte values
            raw_str=data.decode('latin1', errors='ignore')
            # Sometimes text may be embedded; search with regex on raw string
            try:
                amt=parse_total_from_text(raw_str)
                amounts[mo]=amt
                print('month', mo, 'amt_from_pdf_raw', amt)
                continue
            except Exception as e:
                print('month', mo, 'pdf_raw_parse_fail', type(e), e)
                # fallback: also search for 'Total Amount' vicinity and parse digits after
                idx=raw_str.find('Total Amount')
                print('idx_total_amount', idx)
                snippet=raw_str[idx:idx+200] if idx!=-1 else raw_str[:200]
                print('snippet', snippet)
                amt=parse_total_from_text(snippet)
        else:
            # content not in expected format; convert to str
            text=str(content)
            amt=parse_total_from_text(text)
    amt=parse_total_from_text(text)
    amounts[mo]=amt
    print('month', mo, 'amt', amt)

print('amounts', amounts)
print('total', sum(amounts.values()))

from datetime import datetime

fs_token=login['access_token']

# current year from environment
current_year=str(datetime.now().year)

# internet txt bills for current year (found by filename under ~/bills/**)
all_files=apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=fs_token,directory_path='~/bills/',entry_type='files',recursive=True)
pattern=re.compile(r'/(\d{4})-(\d{2})\.txt$')

internet_txt_2023=[p for p in all_files if '/internet/' in p and pattern.search(p) and pattern.search(p).group(1)==current_year]
print('internet_txt_2023', sorted(internet_txt_2023))

# parse Total Amount

def parse_total(txt):
    m=re.search(r"Total Amount\s*=>\s*\$?\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)", txt)
    if not m:
        raise ValueError('Total Amount not found')
    return Decimal(m.group(1))

amounts=[]
for p in sorted(internet_txt_2023):
    f=apis.file_system.show_file(access_token=fs_token,file_path=p)
    txt=f['content']
    amt=parse_total(txt)
    print('file',p,'amt',amt)
    amounts.append(amt)

total=sum(amounts)
print('total', total)
